subject: Execution handoff & authorization timetable
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Jamie — attaching an updated mutual action plan (MAP) and a proposed evaluation cadence for the last-mile signoff. Key asks here: confirm the authorized signer window, procurement lead time for your PO, and whether we should target a 2027-04-05 or 2027-04-12 go-live for the pilot start.

Highlights: 
- MAP v2 attached: breaks milestones into Legal review (3 business days), Procurement PO (5 business days after SOW), and Tech handoff/validation (3 days).
- Evaluation plan: 2-week pilot with production-like traffic for throughput and latency checks; acceptance criteria listed on page 3.
- Signer window options: (A) 3/29–3/31 (preferred), (B) 4/5–4/9 (backup).

Can you confirm which signer window your procurement team expects and who will be the authorized signer? If you want a later start, we can push resourcing but that will move the onboarding kickoff.

Attachments: Nimbus-MAP-v2.pdf, Redwood-SOW-v1.3.docx

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Thanks, Olga — reviewed and this looks clean. A few notes from procurement:
- Procurement lead time is usually 7 business days for external SOWs that require PO issuance. We can accelerate to 5 if legal signs off without redlines.
- Authorized signer will be our CFO (Anita) — she is on copy. Anita prefers signer window B (4/5–4/9) due to a board travel week at the end of March.

For the evaluation plan, the 2-week pilot is acceptable but we need a pre-pilot dry run (1 day) to validate synthetic traffic and onboarding scripts. Can Redwood commit to a dry run on day 0 of the pilot?

I will ask procurement to prepare a preliminary PO and route it for signature as soon as we have the final SOW.

—Jamie
Director of Digital Ops, Nimbus Health
jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Looping in legal and delivery notes here with Jamie's procurement feedback. Quick internal summary and recommended plan: 

- Procurement: expect 5–7 business days; Anita (CFO) prefers 4/5–4/9 signer window.
- Impact to resourcing: pushing to 4/12 start (if Anita wants time to review) costs us one week of reserved engineer ramp; we can absorb but should communicate the slight shift to the onboarding team.
- Dry run: delivery can commit to a 1-day dry run on "day 0" of the pilot; ops will run synthetic workload and smoke tests.

Recommended next steps:
1) Update SOW with a clear clause: "PO issuance within 7 business days after SOW finalization; pilot dry run scheduled immediately prior to acceptance window."
2) Prepare DocuSign envelope and set signer window for 4/05–4/09 unless Jamie confirms a hard preference for earlier.
3) Marissa to confirm if any billing terms need pre-approval for the accelerated 5-day procurement path.

If everyone is aligned I can kick off the DocuSign flow and mark the delivery calendar.

-Vivek
Head of Dedicated Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Thanks for the summary — a couple of legal/billing points before we send the DocuSign: 
- Redlines: we received one contractual exception request from Nimbus on data retention (their security team asks for a 13‑month retention baseline for logs). I recommend we accept with the standard caveat language (see clause 7b).
- Billing: if Jamie wants the 5-day procurement acceleration, procurement must route "Expedite Approval" and confirm the PO will include "Net 30" payment terms. If they ask for Net 45 we need Finance sign-off.
- DocuSign setup: I can build the envelope but would prefer the SOW final text in a shared doc link — we should avoid iterative attachments.

Action items for Olga: push the updated SOW link and confirm signer window (we'll default to 4/05–4/09). Once Jamie confirms, I'll create the DocuSign envelope and include the acceptance checklist for the pilot.

Marissa Cole
Contracts & Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Olga / Marissa — confirmed. Anita will sign in the 4/05–4/09 window; procurement will issue PO NIM-PO-12345 the week of 3/29 and target routing for expedited approval. We accept the 13-month log retention language.

Agree to the dry run on day 0 — procurement will attach the PO and we will countersign through DocuSign. I've attached the preliminary PO (Nimbus-PO-12345.pdf) to this thread for reference. Please send the DocuSign envelope when SOW text is finalized.

Thanks all — go/no-go looks green from our side.

—Jamie
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Lee <jamie.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Execution handoff & authorization timetable

Perfect — appreciate the quick turnaround, Jamie. I'll: 
- Publish final SOW link in the shared drive and notify Marissa (SOW includes the accepted 13-month retention clause).
- Mark DocuSign signer window 4/05–4/09 and ask legal to pre-seed the envelope.
- Confirm onboarding kickoff for Monday 4/12 with a 1-day dry run followed by the 2-week pilot.

Attaching final checklist with milestone dates and resource owner names for your PM. Welcome any last-minute flag but tagging this as "go" from Redwood.

Thanks,
Olga
